audio_sample_loop.finding: A sample load and unchanged writeback compile to the complete original32-byte empty native loop, including unsigned JBE, natural alignment and all bytes. Native C compiler removes the identity memory operations after the opportunity to remove the loop.
audio_sample_loop.interpretation: This recovers a compiler mechanism and a minimal source shape, not a unique historical expression. Plain empty loop and unused sample calculations are eliminated. No source change was promoted merely on this diagnostic.

int return type with no return, unused load, unused clamp, and unused swapped value are eliminated.
